svg.title: Gear architecture
svg.desc: Algorithm Registry configures the Optimization Engine. Task Registry and Agent feed the engine, which sends candidates to Evaluator. Evaluator writes Trajectory Storage. Storage returns feedback to the engine and supplies Trainer. The engine updates seed tasks in Task Registry and the harness in Agent. Trainer returns model updates to Agent. The circular Serve, Diagnose, Evolve overview is synchronized with highlighted components and moving data on the corresponding paths. Hitch's four shared infrastructure capabilities stay static.

g.text: Customize the modules below to improve agents
